# anthropic_deployment (Resource)

Manages a Managed Agents deployment: an agent plus environment, initial events, mounted resources and an optional cron schedule that fires sessions autonomously.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

~> Deployments cannot be deleted. `terraform destroy` **archives** the deployment (terminal). Set `archive_on_destroy = false` to only remove it from state. The provider always pins an explicit `agent_version`, so the API's re-pin-to-latest behaviour never produces drift. A deployment the platform pauses because a referenced object was archived shows `paused = true` with `paused_reason_type = "error"`, which surfaces as drift until you fix the reference.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "github_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "anthropic_deployment" "nightly_report" {
  name           = "nightly-incident-report"
  agent_id       = "agent_01ExampleAgentId0000000000"
  agent_version  = 3
  environment_id = "env_01ExampleEnvId000000000000"

  initial_events = jsonencode([
    {
      type    = "user.message"
      content = [{ type = "text", text = "Summarize yesterday's incidents and open a tracking issue." }]
    }
  ])

  schedule = {
    cron_expression = "0 6 * * 1-5"
    timezone        = "UTC"
  }

  github_repositories = [{
    url                 = "https://github.com/example-org/example-repo"
    authorization_token = var.github_token
    checkout_branch     = "main"
  }]

  vault_ids                  = [anthropic_vault.ci.id]
  budget_max_list_cost_cents = "50000"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Agent to run (`agent_...`).
- `environment_id` (String) Environment to run in (`env_...`).
- `initial_events` (String) JSON array of 1 to 50 initial events (`user.message`, `user.define_outcome`, `system.message`). Compared semantically; server-added fields are ignored.
- `name` (String) Name, 1 to 256 characters.

### Optional

- `agent_version` (Number) Agent version to pin. Defaults to the agent's latest version at creation and then stays fixed; set it explicitly (for example to `anthropic_agent.x.version`) to roll forward.
- `archive_on_destroy` (Boolean) Archive on destroy (default `true`); `false` only removes the resource from state. Imported resources start with `false`, so removing one from configuration cannot destroy it until you opt in.
- `budget_max_list_cost_cents` (String) Per-run budget cap in USD cents as an integer string. Omit for no cap.
- `description` (String) Description (max 2048).
- `files` (Attributes List) Files (Files API ids) mounted into each session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `github_repositories` (Attributes List) Git repositories mounted into each session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--github_repositories))
- `memory_stores` (Attributes List) Memory stores mounted into each session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--memory_stores))
- `metadata` (Map of String) Key/value metadata (up to 16 pairs).
- `paused` (Boolean) Pause scheduled runs. Defaults to `false`. Also becomes `true` when the platform pauses the deployment after an error.
- `schedule` (Attributes) Cron schedule. Omit for a manual-only deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `vault_ids` (List of String) Vaults whose credentials sessions may use (max 50).

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp; null while live.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Deployment id (`depl_...`).
- `last_run_at` (String) Timestamp of the last run.
- `paused_reason_error` (String) Error type behind an error pause.
- `paused_reason_type` (String) `manual` or `error` when paused; null otherwise.
- `status` (String) `active` or `paused`.
- `upcoming_runs_at` (List of String) Next scheduled run timestamps (up to 5).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Required:

- `file_id` (String) File id.

Optional:

- `mount_path` (String) Mount path inside the session.


<a id="nestedatt--github_repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `github_repositories`

Required:

- `url` (String) Repository URL. Must use `https://`; the authorization token is sent to this host.

Optional:

- `authorization_token` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Token used to clone private repositories. Write-only: sent to the API, never stored in state, never drift-detected. Requires Terraform 1.11 or newer.
- `checkout_branch` (String) Branch to check out.
- `checkout_commit` (String) Commit SHA to check out (instead of a branch).
- `mount_path` (String) Mount path inside the session.


<a id="nestedatt--memory_stores"></a>
### Nested Schema for `memory_stores`

Required:

- `memory_store_id` (String) Memory store id (`memstore_...`).

Optional:

- `access` (String) `read_write` (default) or `read_only`.
- `instructions` (String) Instructions for using the store (max 4096).


<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `cron_expression` (String) Five-field POSIX cron expression.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone, for example `UTC`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_deployment.nightly_report depl_01ExampleDeployId00000000
```
